statement: At lr >= 3e-3 the stage-1 router is a limit cycle between select-all and select-none: the ratio loss constrains only the mean of p, so a uniform bias shift flips every position.

consequence: Rank-based (quantile) boundary decisions (EXP-014) that pin compression and are immune to uniform shifts.

statement: The p-space quantile rule saturates: with the threshold detached nothing anchors the logit scale, sigmoid becomes exactly 1.0 for more than 1/N positions and the stage dies.

consequence: Decider rewritten to rank batch-normalized fp32 logits with a midpoint threshold; rule: every decision rule needs a scale anchor.
